_doc: Where a reader marked the STAND-IN's facial landmarks (Anna Åkerman, a Swedish housemaid born in 1863, in a cabinet card of 1890-1895 (Bohusläns museum, UMFA53226:1855); not Christine Nelson), in pixels of the crop `crop_px` of the copy named in `scan`. Her face is turned three-quarters to her right, so her LEFT ear (the reader's right) is marked. The copy is small (her face is about 40 px across), so every mark carries a wide uncertainty. `base_body` fits against Christine Nelson's own body's rest face.
age_note: Born 1863 by the card and photographed in 1890-1895, she was 27 to 32; 30 is the middle. The renderer's ageing pair takes the face to Christine Nelson's own 31 at the scene date.
basis: No photograph of Christine Nelson is known. Her face's proportions are fitted to a stand-in: Anna Åkerman, a Swedish housemaid born in 1863, in a cabinet card of 1890-1895 (Bohusläns museum, UMFA53226:1855), a Swedish woman in domestic service of about her age. It is not her: what the face shows is that kind of woman, not Christine Nelson, so the face is reconstructed.
not_modelled: her own face (no photograph of her is known; this is a stand-in's)
her hair (the stand-in's is light, centre-parted and drawn back; the model wears the town's bun under a hat)

stand_in.label: STAND-IN, NOT CHRISTINE NELSON
stand_in.card_note: No photograph of Christine Nelson is known. This is a stand-in: Anna Åkerman, a Swedish housemaid photographed in Uddevalla about 1890-1895 at about thirty, close to Christine Nelson's age, country and work. Her face is the model's guide; it is not Christine Nelson.

card._doc: What the person's card shows (T-3413, T-3478): `portrait` is cut from the copy at `portrait_from_scan_px` and scaled to `size_px` by tools/cut_portrait.py (a stand-in's label burned on it); `model` is tools/portrait_still.mjs's render of the fitted face on `body`, turned to the fit's yaw, dressed as humans.js dresses the person in town.
